evidence_snippets: Because ML models are not perfect and have a certain error rate, and because errors in splitting are typically very problematic (a bad split makes two documents wrong and causes extraction errors), a best practice is to always have a human review step after the splitting prediction but before the actual file split.
Splitter description and usage You can create custom splitters that are specifically suited to your documents and trained and evaluated with your data, or deploy pretrained models with generative AI.
